title: Halloween potato eyeballs
creator: buzzfeedtasty
statusNote: Amounts aren't given; the full recipe is on the creator's site (by @whisperofyum). The ≈ amounts are estimates.
steps: Steam the diced potatoes, then pass them through a ricer.
Add the tapioca starch and salt and knead until smooth.
Divide into 4, roll each into a rope, cut into 2–3 cm pieces and roll into balls.
Dye a little of the dough black for the pupils. Top each eyeball with an olive slice and a small piece of black dough.
Cook in boiling water until they float, then move to an ice bath.
Serve in a jar with chilli oil.
